title: About Dr. Jitesh Kumar, Founder - Atlas Mentor
description: Dr. Jitesh Kumar leads Atlas Mentor's admissions counselling for Indian students pursuing MBBS abroad, overseeing NMC-compliance guidance across all partner countries.
body:
Dr. Jitesh Kumar

Founder & Senior Medical Education Consultant, Atlas Mentor

Dr. Jitesh Kumar founded Atlas Mentor (operated by Elitestudy Abroad Pvt. Ltd.) to guide Indian students through MBBS admissions at NMC-approved medical universities abroad. He leads the counselling team that reviews and signs off on the university and country guides published on this site, so the fee figures, eligibility criteria, and NMC-compliance information reflect what Atlas Mentor's counsellors actually advise students day to day, rather than generic web content.

What Dr. Jitesh Kumar and the Atlas Mentor team review

  • NMC (National Medical Commission) approval status for every university and country listed on this site.
  • Tuition and living-cost figures, checked against current university fee schedules.
  • Eligibility criteria, including NEET-UG qualification requirements for Indian applicants.
  • Visa and pre-departure guidance based on current embassy and consular requirements.

A note on accuracy

Fee figures, intake dates, and regulatory requirements change from year to year. Every guide reviewed by Dr. Jitesh Kumar and the Atlas Mentor team lists the date it was last checked. If you're reading a page that hasn't been updated recently, or if a figure looks out of date, contact us and we'll confirm the current position before you rely on it.

Get in touch with the Atlas Mentor counselling team for a personalized assessment of your eligibility and options.
